fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy

Enum ExecutionMode

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<ExecutionMode>
      • fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.ExecutionMode
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<ExecutionMode>

    public enum ExecutionMode
extends java.lang.Enum<ExecutionMode>
    The enumeration ExecutionMode defines the basic types of execution in which BCM4JavaCyPhy components can run.

    Description

    Execution modes are used to guide the scenarios that the components will execute in a run.

    • STANDARD means that the components run as a real world deployment or runs its test manually without using the BCM4Java test functionalities.
    • UNIT_TEST means that the component is tested in the least possible configuration, most of the times with only another component used to call its services to check if it runs as expected.
    • UNIT_TEST_WITH_SIL_SIMULATION means that the component is tested in the least possible configuration using software-in-the-loop simulation, most of the times with only another component used to call its services to check if it runs as expected.
    • UNIT_TEST_WITH_HIL_SIMULATION means that the component is tested in the least possible configuration using hardware-in-the-loop simulation, most of the times with only another component used to call its services to check if it runs as expected.
    • INTEGRATION_TEST means that the component runs in a configuration as similar to the standard deployment but to test if the entire application runs as expected.
    • INTEGRATION_TEST_WITH_SIL_SIMULATION means that the component runs in a configuration as similar to the standard deployment but with software-in-the-loop simulation to test if the entire application runs as expected.
    • INTEGRATION_TEST_WITH_HIL_SIMULATION means that the component runs in a configuration as similar to the standard deployment but with hardware-in-the-loop simulation to test if the entire application runs as expected

    Methods are provided to test convenient combinations of these modes, like tests without simulaiton or tests with simulation.

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant
